name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in a small village, his fascination with machines was sparked by the local mechanic's workshop. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he found an entry-level position at a local automotive company, quickly rising through the ranks due to his meticulous attention to detail. An opportunity presented itself to join a small racing team, where he discovered his true passion: ensuring the highest quality standards for racing components.

Li Wei's approach to quality control is rigorous yet pragmatic. He believes in a proactive approach, identifying potential issues before they escalate into major problems. He's known for his ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical systems under pressure, always striving for perfection without sacrificing efficiency. What sets him apart is his unwavering dedication and his ability to adapt to ever-changing demands of motorsport. He is a firm believer that quality is not just a goal, but a culture that needs to be fostered within a team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Li Wei is of average height and build, with a serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on thoroughly testing all equipment himself before approving it.
